title: Downloads folder
whyItMatters: Browsers and chat apps save installers, invoices, tickets and photos here. It is often the biggest pile of personal files on the machine.
source: XDG user directories defaults (xdg-user-dirs creates Downloads under the home directory): https://www.freedesktop.org/wiki/Software/xdg-user-dirs/
notes: The folder name comes from ~/.config/user-dirs.dirs and can be localised or renamed, which this rule does not detect. Telegram and some browsers use their own subfolder inside it.
